blocks.title: Operations
blocks.text: Advantest manufactures and sells semiconductor and component test systems and mechatronics-related products; its described activities also include customer solutions support and equipment leasing.

evidence.quote: manufacture and sale of semiconductor and component test system products and mechatronics-related products

blocks.title: Product scope
blocks.text: The source describes test systems for semiconductor and electronic-component industries, plus semiconductor-device handling products including testers, handlers, device interfaces, and nanotechnology products.

evidence.quote: test systems for semiconductors and electronic component industries

blocks.title: Later-period demand context (FY2024 Q1)
blocks.text: In its FY2024 first-quarter briefing, management said semiconductor performance and rising complexity were driving demand growth, with tester demand—especially for SoC testers—rising faster than originally expected. This is later-period context, not a 2016-period claim.

evidence.quote: increasing complexity is raising tester demand more rapidly than originally expected, especially for SOC testers

blocks.title: Documented facts and inferred buyer archetypes

cells: The FY2024 Q1 briefing refers to product deliveries to customers but does not name customers in the supplied excerpt.

evidence.quote: our product deliveries to customers exceeded our original plan

cells: The company overview describes customer solutions support and equipment leasing services.

evidence.quote: customer solutions support, and equipment leasing services

cells: Potential buyer archetypes include organizations in semiconductor and electronic-component industries; no specific buyer or customer is identified.

blocks.title: Demand driver (FY2024 Q1 context)
blocks.text: Management identified semiconductor performance and rising complexity as demand drivers; this statement is from FY2024 Q1, not the 2016 filing period.

evidence.quote: continued demand growth driven by semiconductor performance and rising complexity

blocks.title: Forward-looking uncertainty
blocks.text: The FY2024 briefing cautioned that forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainty that may cause actual results to differ. The supplied excerpt does not specify individual risk factors.

evidence.quote: all of which are subject to risks and uncertainty that may cause our actual results to be different
